# Loss Curves
```{python}
sensing_terminals = ["Name", "Deitic", "Base"]
path_end = "loss_results.npz"
result_path = Path("results")

for terminal in sensing_terminals:
    clone_data = np.load(result_path / experiment / terminal / "Clone" / path_end)
    free_data = np.load(result_path / experiment / terminal / "Free" / path_end)
    restricted_data = np.load(result_path / experiment / terminal / "Restricted" / path_end)  # fmt: skip

    plot_loss_curves(
        clone_data, free_data, restricted_data, title=f"{experiment}: {terminal}"
    )
``` 


# Vector Operation Heatmaps

```{python}
terminals = ["Base", "Deitic", "Name"]
strategies = ["Clone", "Free", "Restricted"]
history_path = "pride_history.jsonl"
```

## Base
```{python}
for strategy in strategies:
    path = result_path / experiment / "Base" / strategy / history_path
    plot_heatmaps(
        path,
        gens=[0, 5, 10, 15, 51],
        title_spec=f"{experiment} Base {strategy}",
        terminal="Base",
        max_depth=config.max_depth,
    )
gc.close('all')
```

## Deitic
```{python}
for strategy in strategies:
    path = result_path / experiment / "Deitic" / strategy / history_path
    plot_heatmaps(
        path,
        gens=[0, 5, 10, 15, 51],
        title_spec=f"{experiment} Deitic {strategy}",
        terminal="Deitic",
        max_depth=config.max_depth,
    )
gc.close('all')

```

## Name
```{python}
for strategy in strategies:
```

# Animations
```{python}
anim = Path("animations")
qualities = ["best_positions", "random_positions"]
generations = ["first", "final"]
```

## Base
```{python}
for strategy, quality, generation in product(strategies, qualities, generations):
    path = anim / experiment / "Base" / strategy / f"{quality}_{generation}.html"
    with open(path) as f:
        display(HTML(f.read()))
```
